channel.title: BBQ Pioneer Product Feed
channel.description: Premium grills and smokers from BBQ Pioneer

items.title: Titan Pro Offset Smoker 1000
items.description: The Titan Pro Offset Smoker 1000 is the crown jewel of competition BBQ. Hand-welded from 1/4-inch steel, this 1,000-square-inch cooking behemoth delivers legendary low-and-slow results. Favored by World Championship Pitmasters for its unmatched heat retention and precision airflow control.
items.google_product_category: Home & Garden > Kitchen & Dining > Outdoor Grills & Griddles

items.title: Inferno Kamado XL
items.description: The Inferno Kamado XL reimagines ceramic cooking for the modern pitmaster. Its aerospace-grade ceramic body retains heat with surgical precision — hit 225°F for 18-hour slow smokes or blast to 750°F for restaurant-quality sears. Versatility meets perfection.
items.google_product_category: Home & Garden > Kitchen & Dining > Outdoor Grills & Griddles

items.title: Pioneer Pellet Pro 1200
items.description: Set it. Forget it. Dominate. The Pioneer Pellet Pro 1200 brings WiFi-enabled precision to your backyard. Control your cook from anywhere via the BBQ Pioneer app. With 1,200 square inches of cooking space and a 30-lb hopper, this beast handles the longest overnight brisket sessions without breaking a sweat.
items.google_product_category: Home & Garden > Kitchen & Dining > Outdoor Grills & Griddles

items.title: Blacksmith Gas Grill 6000
items.description: When only the absolute best will do, there's the Blacksmith Gas Grill 6000. Six commercial-grade burners output 60,000 BTUs of pure fire power. All 304 stainless steel construction that's built to weather decades. This is the grill that separates the serious from the casual.
items.google_product_category: Home & Garden > Kitchen & Dining > Outdoor Grills & Griddles

items.title: Ember Portable Charcoal Grill
items.description: Premium portability meets uncompromising quality. The Ember Portable Charcoal Grill packs a serious punch in a tailgate-ready package. Built from 18-gauge stainless steel with folding legs and a lockable dome, it's the grill champions take on the road.
items.google_product_category: Home & Garden > Kitchen & Dining > Outdoor Grills & Griddles

items.title: Vortex Charcoal Kettle XL
items.description: The classic evolved. The Vortex Charcoal Kettle XL takes the timeless kettle design and pushes it to its absolute limit with a 26-inch cooking grate, dual-zone Vortex technology for incredible high-heat searing, and premium porcelain enamel that never chips.
